minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, September 20, 2023
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order
  at 10:00 AM on Wednesday, September 20, 2023.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Bette Donovan, Edward Padgett,
  and Scott Snider.

  Members Absent: Jenny Jolly and Rafaela Giles.

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Director, Armando
  Cisneros, Community Services Specialist, Robyn Olsen, Community Services
  Specialist.

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, August 16,
  2023 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Paulina Ale, Program Coordinator and Rachel Straight, Tri-City
  Mental Health. Presented updates on programs available through Tri-City.
  Innovation and Developing Psychiatric Advance Directives in California and the
  Garden Program.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: Meals were served to an average of 34 participants per week
  in August.

  Meals on Wheels: 713 meals served to 42 La Verne recipients in August.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account for the month of July was
  $303.25. The average attendance for August was 58 players per week. The
  cost of paper is higher so they will be raising the prices. Bingo changed from
  Friday to Wednesday.

5. Account Balance: $5,316.44

6. Senior Program Fees: Bridge and Woodcarvers have not paid. All other programs
  our up-to-date.
 7. MT. SAC Classes: Fall session for Mt. SAC has begun.

8. Aging Next: August total number of La Verne residents served was 11. (via
  Joslyn Center and Aging Next office).

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Bids for roofing. Aquatic center received a grant.

10. Upcoming Events:

  - Thursday, September 21 – Excursion, Colorful Songs of Broadway, Rogers and
  Hammerstein Show, 10:45AM-4:30PM
  - Friday, September 22 – Senior Seminar: Medicare, Presented by TMB
  Insurance Services, 9:30AM
  - Monday, September 25 – Health and Resource Fair, 9:00AM-11:30AM
  - Wednesday, October 4 – Excursion: Living Desert Zoo and Gardens Safari
  Tour, 8:00AM-4:30PM
  - Monday, October 9 – Movie Matinee, 12:30AM
  - Wednesday, October 11– Senior Seminar: Using Reverse Mortgage to your Advantage,
  Presented by Change Home Mortgage
  - October 17 – Excursion: Apple Season in Oak Glen with Tavern Lunch and Apple Cider
  Donuts, 9:30AM-3:30PM

11. Public Comments: Bette asked for information on how to have Bunco at the Center.
  Yvonne will get more information and Bette will try to get information on how other
  volunteer’s work. George gave an update on Golf. Average amount of players is 18.
  New people expecting to join. Ed has joined the RSVP program. Scott gave an
  update on Hillcrest. Yvonne announced the increase in fee for senior programs from
  $0.50 cents to $1 per participant beginning next year.

12. Adjourn: It was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 11:00AM.
  Motion carried. The next meeting will be on Wednesday, October 18, 2023 at
  10:00 AM.
